newsitem.title: USA: Marriott says gets FTC ok to buy Renaissance.
newsitem.headline: Marriott says gets FTC ok to buy Renaissance.

text.p: Marriott International Inc said Wednesday the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvement Act condition has been satisfied regarding its previously announced offer to buy the Renaissance Hotel Group N.V for $30 per share, cash. The waiting period under the Act was accelerated by the Federal Trade Commission and clearance was received on March 10.
In February the two companies announced a definitive agreement under which Marriott would acquire Renaissance, a premier operator and franchisor of 150 hotels in 38 countries.
The tender offer will remain open until 1201 EST, March 29, unless otherwise extended.
